summary: Desktop toolbar rows and pickers share two shadcn-style primitives. components/ui/toolbar.tsx holds the one-row Toolbar (a container), ToolbarItem (leaves the row below a step), the "..." ToolbarOverflow and useContainerTier; components/ui/toolbar-steps.ts holds the steps and the overflow rule; components/ui/chip.tsx holds the 24 px chip, ChipSelect and OptionList. The composer footer, the chat header, the terminal pane header and the Kanban toolbar use them; the footer and the chat header look the same as before. Every remaining native <select> (Kanban filters, the Kanban card's project, status and runtime mode, and the sidebar organizer's workspace picker) is now the ui Combobox list, and an ESLint rule plus a unit test fail on a native <select> outside components/ui.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app has no Kanban board, no sidebar organizer and none of these desktop toolbars; its own controls are React Native components.

nativeAndroid.reason: The Compose app renders none of these desktop renderer components, and nothing it shows changes.

sharedBackendApi.reason: A renderer component change only. The Kanban filters, card fields and workspace moves send the same values through the same IPC calls.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes. The pickers store the same values; their internal sentinels for "all" and "ungrouped" map back to null before any write.

updateRelease.reason: An unconditional desktop renderer change with no flag, package identity, signing, update-channel or rollout change.

automated: npx vitest run tests/unit/toolbar.test.ts tests/unit/no-native-select.test.ts tests/unit/tailwind-sources.test.ts
SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens npm run test:e2e:visual (every composer and chat screen unchanged; only the kanban screens changed, for the filter pickers)
